== Summary ==
The [[DecipherCon 1999 website]] home page as archived on 28 November 1999, after the convention. Screenshot of the Internet Archive's copy, rendered in a desktop browser at 800 pixels wide. See [[DecipherCon 1999 website]] and [[1999 Decipher World Championship]].

== Source ==
* [http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/index.html DecipherCon 1999 home page], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991128065643/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/index.html Internet Archive]
* Rendered with headless Chrome (Playwright) on 27 October 2026 from the archived HTML and the archived images. Site-wide decipher.com icons that the Wayback Machine did not save are left blank.
* Page content: Decipher.

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-1/13/DecipherCon_1999_website_home_page.png Internet Archive item].
